criterion_fired: Criterion 2 (Carry-forward consistency) — Decision Criteria, Decision Process, Champion
suggested_change: Carry-forward rule: Score drops only if prospect contradicts prior information. If no new information exists, carry forward prior score with explicit note 'unvalidated.' Absence of evidence ≠ evidence of regression. Example: 'Champion authority 8/10 (February); internal advocacy unvalidated (no April evidence) — maintain 8/10 with caveat' rather than dropping to 2/10.
